0022600121.text: The Celtics, playing their third game of the season, are 1-1 overall and 1-0 at home, sitting 3rd in the Atlantic, one game back, and 7th in the East, while the Bulls are also 1-1 but 1-1 on the road, 2nd in the Central, one game back, and 8th in the East. Boston will be without Devin Carter, who is out with illness, and Chicago is missing Nic Claxton (hamstring), Noa Essengue (head bruise), and Patrick Williams (groin soreness). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but the Celtics won the 2025-26 season series 2-1, including a 124-105 win in Boston on February 11, 2026.
